theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s h : ℝ), 0 < n → IsOpen U → R.Represents T → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → u 0 = 0 → {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} ⊆ U → R.measure.support ∩ {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} = (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s → z ∈ T.support → z ∈ regularSet T
